rich_narrative.summary: Dream.Org's overall performance is limited by severe financial sustainability challenges and a program expense ratio that falls below industry standards. In FY2024, the organization generated <cite id="[9]">$5,715,452 in total revenue</cite>, but reported spending that far exceeded its annual income. The organization allocates a <cite id="[8]">program expense ratio of 68.4%</cite>, leaving more than 31% directed to administrative and fundraising costs. This falls short of the 75% sector benchmark. Additionally, officer compensation absorbs a substantial portion of organizational resources, with executive pay representing 4.3% of revenue in recent filings. The charity focuses on domestic advocacy and capacity building across clean energy and justice reform through initiatives like Green For All and Tech For All. While it maintains <cite id="[8]">a 94/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite> and tracks key program outcomes, its high cost per beneficiary of approximately $17,806 reflects an intensive advocacy model with limited direct service reach.
